newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada help wanted index rises 3.0 pct in January.
newsitem.headline: Canada help wanted index rises 3.0 pct in January.

text.p: Canada's help wanted index, seasonally adjusted, rose 3.0 percent in January to 96 (1991=100) from 93 in December, Statistics Canada said on Thursday.

The help wanted index monitors changes in help wanted advertisements in 20 cities. It reflects the intent of employers in these labor markets to hire new workers. Increases in the index are usually followed by drops in the unemployment rate.
A Reuters survey of economists had forecast a rise in the index to 94 points.
(For more information on this release from Statistics Canada's Labour Division, contact Michael Scrim at 613-951-4090.)
